messages:
maya: Quick PRD intake — I want to propose a "Fastlane" onboarding flow for Dedicated customers to reduce setup friction and time-to-first-inference. Problem statement below, please skim and flag gaps.

maya: Problem: small-to-mid customers keep spinning up Dedicated trials but hit multiple manual blockers: VPC networking confusions, model pinning choices, cold-start performance surprises, and lack of templated prompts/evals. Result: onboarding takes ~2+ weeks, lots of SE handholding, and churn risk.

omar: +1. We should capture acceptance criteria and non-goals early. Also think about API-first vs console-first paths.

tess: Design angle: customers want a 1-page checklist and a sample app they can run in <1 hour. Keep console UI for Fastlane minimal — progressive disclosure.

liam: Infra note: we'll need a single-click dedicated stack with sane network defaults + a lightweight autoscale policy. Cold-start SLOs are currently unmeasured for these small pools; we should add telemetry.

nina: From CS: customers repeatedly ask for a reproducible test prompt set and an easy way to validate latency/cost before committing. Success metrics should include "time to first successful request" and reduction in SE support tickets.

maya: Draft goals (proposed):
- Goal 1: Reduce time-to-first-successful-inference to <= 24 hours for Fastlane customers.
- Goal 2: Provide a self-serve, templated stack (network + model + autoscale + sample app) that requires zero infra modifications for 75% of small tenants.
- Goal 3: Ship a minimal verification harness (3 prompts + latency/cost dashboard) to let customers validate quality/cost tradeoffs.

maya: Non-goals (proposed):
- Not covering enterprise air-gapped on-prem installs for initial launch (that is a separate Private product project).
- Not trying to support heavy custom VPC/topology cases on day 1.

maya: Proposed success metrics (must be quantifiable):
- Primary: median time from account activation to first successful inference <= 24h (tracked via onboarding telemetry).
- Secondary: % of Fastlane signups that complete onboarding without SE intervention >= 75% within 30 days.
- Operational: reduce SE onboarding tickets related to Dedicated setup by 50% for participating customers.

maya: Acceptance criteria (MVP):
1) Console flow + API path that provisions a dedicated test pool with default autoscale (configurable later).
2) Minimal network defaults that work with most cloud VPCs and clear diagnostics on failures.
3) A sample app + 3 canonical test prompts + automatic evaluation of latency/cost and a pass/fail check.
4) Telemetry emitted for each onboarding step (provision, first-infer, eval results).
5) Docs + one-pager checklist.

omar: Edge cases to call out:
- Customers using very long context models ( > 32k ) may hit provisioning or cost ceilings — show clear guardrails.
- Air-gapped/regulated customers should be routed to Private track — surface as a blocker.
- Multi-tenant teams that expect tenant-level isolation; Fastlane should default to single-tenant test pools.

tess: UX acceptance: onboarding should be completable in a guided flow that shows progress and a single call-to-action "Run validation". Error states must show a clear next step or contact link.

liam: Rollout constraints: we need telemetry, automated cleanup for test pools, and a small canary (5 customers) before broad release. Also, implement a budget cap to protect from runaway spend.

nina: Customer selection for canary — pick 3 existing SMB customers and 2 trial signups willing to test. CS will own outreach.

omar: Technical lift estimate (high level): 2 sprints for infra + deployment templates, 1 sprint for API/console, 1 sprint for telemetry + evaluation harness. Depends on capacity.

maya: Next steps: I'll draft a short PRD this week with the sections above + an onboarding checklist. Can @omar volunteer to be eng lead? @tess for design? @liam for infra? @nina for CS coordination?

omar: I can lead eng on this.

tess: Happy to own design.

liam: I can take infra.

nina: I'll coordinate canary candidates and support docs.

jira-bot: Created PRD-872: "Fastlane Dedicated Onboarding" and linked to docs, assignees: maya, omar, tess, liam, nina — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-872 :ticket:

maya: Thanks — I'll put a draft in the doc and ping for a review by EOW. If anyone has additional failure modes we missed, drop them here. :thumbsup:
